MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S.

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Marketing? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Marketing.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition 2.4 Fish Marketing 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1 Fundamentals of.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
